IPT.evidence_source: [/page/8/Text/5] CBT therapists were trained to use the Primary and Secondary Control Enhancement Training (PASCET) program (Weisz, Thurber, Sweeney, Proffitt, & LeGagnoux, 1997). PASCET is built on findings concerning cognitive and behavioral features of, and beneficial treatments for, youth depression (e.g., Lewinsohn et al., 1990; Stark, Reynolds, & Kaslow, 1987)
